sentences.text: The plotting exam is a set of questions you work on the training chart, and you need seventy percent to pass.
The questions often build on each other, like a real voyage: you plot a departure, lay a course, take bearings, find a fix, work out the current, and compute an arrival time.
That means an early mistake can carry through several answers.
Keep a scratch sheet showing every step, so you can find an error quickly.
Let’s walk through a complete problem.
